cameliaStan.name: Camelia Stan
cameliaStan.shortBio: Founding attorney with over 15 years of experience in civil and family law. Dedicated to defending clients' rights with professionalism and empathy.
cameliaStan.fullBio: Attorney Camelia Stan is co-founder of Stan-Baculescu Law Firm, with over 15 years of experience in the legal field. Specializing in civil law and family law, she has successfully represented hundreds of clients in court, achieving remarkable results in complex divorce, custody, and property division cases. Her approach combines deep legal knowledge with an empathetic understanding of clients' needs.

education.edu2: Member of the Satu Mare Bar Association

vladBaculescu.name: Vlad Baculescu
vladBaculescu.shortBio: Founding attorney specializing in criminal and commercial law. Expert in complex litigation with a high success rate.
vladBaculescu.fullBio: Attorney Vlad Baculescu is co-founder of Stan-Baculescu Law Firm, with extensive experience in criminal and commercial law. He has successfully handled highly complex criminal cases and advised numerous commercial companies on various legal matters. His work style is characterized by rigor, attention to detail, and a strategic approach to each case.

malpraxis-medical.title: Medical Malpractice
malpraxis-medical.subtitle: Professional representation in medical negligence cases to obtain the compensation you deserve.

meta.title: Medical Malpractice | Stan-Baculescu Law Firm
meta.description: Specialized representation in medical malpractice cases. Get the compensation you deserve for medical negligence with our expert attorneys in Satu Mare.

malpraxis-medical.description: Medical malpractice occurs when a healthcare professional makes an error or acts negligently, causing harm to a patient. These cases can include misdiagnosis, surgical errors, medication mistakes, lack of informed consent, or substandard care. Our firm has extensive experience representing victims of medical malpractice, helping them obtain deserved compensation for physical, emotional, and financial suffering caused.

approach.point1: We analyze the complete medical file and consult independent medical experts to evaluate the case.
approach.point2: We document the harm suffered and calculate deserved compensation (medical costs, lost income, pain and suffering).
approach.point3: We negotiate with insurance companies or represent the client in court to obtain compensation.
approach.point4: We keep you informed at every stage of the process and provide support throughout the case.
